name: tokenxiety
description: New tab dashboard for Claude and Codex usage limits.

scripts.syntax: for f in src/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.manifest: python3 -m json.tool manifest.json >/dev/null && python3 -m json.tool src/dnr-rules.json >/dev/null
scripts.validate: npm run manifest && npm run syntax && npm test
scripts.build: rm -rf dist/tokenxiety dist/tokenxiety-quota-tab && mkdir -p dist/tokenxiety && cp manifest.json dist/tokenxiety/ && cp -R src dist/tokenxiety/src && cp -R dist/tokenxiety dist/tokenxiety-quota-tab && cd dist && zip -qr tokenxiety.zip tokenxiety && cd - >/dev/null && echo built dist/tokenxiety
